name: FirstUK Bank SMS Alert Template Suite
canonical_name: FirstUK Bank SMS Alert Template Suite
description: A suite of SMS alert templates designed for FirstUK Bank customer service and operations staff. The suite is version 1.0, effective from 2026-01-15, and covers alert communications to customers. Owned by the Head of Marketing and maintained by the Marketing and Customer Service departments.
context: # FirstUK Bank — SMS Alert Template Suite

name: Time-Sensitive Customer Alert SMS Template
description: A concise SMS message template designed for time-sensitive customer alerts and notifications, optimized for character limits of 160 characters per SMS. Used to deliver urgent information to customers while respecting SMS length constraints.
context: Provide concise SMS message templates for time-sensitive customer alerts and notifications
respecting character limits (160 chars per SMS)
compliance_consideration: concise messaging within SMS character constraints

name: Large Withdrawal Alert
description: An SMS alert template triggered when a customer attempts a withdrawal exceeding £1,000 via mobile or ATM channels. The message notifies the customer of the transaction amount and account identifier, and instructs them to contact the fraud hotline immediately if the transaction was unauthorised.
context: FirstUK: Large withdrawal of £[amount] from your account [last 4 digits]. If not you, call 0800-555-2265 immediately. Ref: [code]
trigger_event: Withdrawal exceeding £1,000 from mobile or ATM

name: Withdrawal Amount
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the monetary value of the large withdrawal transaction, inserted into the SMS alert message to inform the customer of the transaction size.
context: Large withdrawal of £[amount] from your account

name: Account Last Four Digits
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the final four digits of the customer's account number, used to help the customer identify which account the withdrawal was attempted from.

name: Transaction Reference Code
description: A dynamic placeholder for a unique transaction reference code included in the alert message to enable the customer and fraud team to track and reference the specific transaction.

name: Large Withdrawal via Mobile or ATM
canonical_name: Large Withdrawal via Mobile or ATM
key: large withdrawal via mobile or atm|FRAUD_ALERT|banking.communications
description: A fraud detection alert triggered automatically when a withdrawal transaction exceeds £1,000 through mobile or ATM channels. The alert prompts immediate customer verification and provides a fraud hotline contact for unauthorised transaction reporting.
generation_trigger: withdrawal exceeding £1,000 initiated through mobile banking or ATM channel
notification_method: SMS alert with fraud verification prompt
escalation_path: customer to call 0800-555-2265 if transaction not authorized

name: Transfer Sent Confirmation
description: An SMS confirmation template sent to customers upon successful completion of a transfer. The message confirms the transfer amount, recipient name, and updated account balance, with a customer service contact number for queries.
context: FirstUK: Transfer of £[amount] to [recipient name] completed.
Your balance: £[new balance]. Call 0800-555-2265 with questions.

name: Transfer Amount
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the monetary value of the transfer being confirmed to the customer.

name: Recipient Name
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the name of the person or entity receiving the transfer.

name: New Balance
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the customer's updated account balance following the successful transfer.

name: Transfer Completion
description: A successful transfer transaction that triggers the confirmation SMS template. The transfer moves funds from the customer's account to a named recipient.

name: Failed Direct Debit Alert
description: An SMS or push notification template triggered when a Direct Debit payment fails due to insufficient funds or other reasons. The template notifies the customer of the failed payment, the biller, the amount, the failure reason, and directs them to add funds or contact support.
context: Trigger: Direct Debit rejected (insufficient funds, etc.)
FirstUK: Direct Debit of £[amount] to [biller] failed on [date].
Reason: [insufficient funds/other]. Add funds to retry.
key_content: Call to action to add funds and retry

name: Direct Debit Amount
description: The monetary value of the failed Direct Debit payment, inserted dynamically into the alert message.
context: Direct Debit of £[amount] to [biller] failed on [date].

name: Biller Name
description: The name or identifier of the organisation or payee to whom the Direct Debit payment was intended, inserted dynamically into the alert.
context: Direct Debit of £[amount] to [biller] failed on [date].

name: Payment Failure Date
description: The date on which the Direct Debit payment failed, inserted dynamically into the alert message.
context: Direct Debit of £[amount] to [biller] failed on [date].

name: Failure Reason
description: The reason for the Direct Debit rejection, such as insufficient funds or other account issues, inserted dynamically into the alert.

name: Direct Debit Payment Failure
description: A Direct Debit payment instruction that has been rejected at the point of collection, triggering a customer alert. The failure may be due to insufficient funds or other account-related issues.
context: Trigger: Direct Debit rejected (insufficient funds, etc.)
Direct Debit of £[amount] to [biller] failed on [date].
cancellation_or_dispute_process: Customer can add funds and retry; customer service available at 0800-555-2265

name: Card Payment Alert
description: An SMS or push notification alert sent to customers when a contactless or online card payment exceeds £500. The template prompts immediate customer verification and provides a fraud line contact number if the transaction is unauthorised.
context: FirstUK: Card payment of £[amount] at [merchant] on [date] [time]. If not you, call 0800-555-2265 fraud line immediately.

name: Payment Amount
description: The monetary value of the card payment transaction, inserted dynamically into the alert message. Represents the transaction amount that triggered the alert threshold.

name: Merchant Name
description: The name or identifier of the merchant or retailer where the card payment was made, inserted dynamically into the alert.

name: Transaction Date
description: The calendar date on which the card payment transaction occurred, inserted dynamically into the alert message.

name: Transaction Time
description: The time of day at which the card payment transaction was processed, inserted dynamically into the alert.

name: Debit Card
description: The payment card used by the customer for contactless or online transactions that trigger fraud alerts when the transaction value exceeds £500.

name: High-Value Card Payment Fraud Alert
description: An automated fraud detection alert triggered when a contactless or online card payment exceeds £500. The alert is sent to the customer with transaction details and instructions to contact the fraud line if the payment is unauthorised.
context: If not you, call 0800-555-2265 fraud line immediately.
investigation_or_escalation_path: Cardholder to contact fraud line at 0800-555-2265

name: Suspicious Activity Alert
description: An SMS security alert template triggered when fraud detection rules identify moderate-risk unusual activity on a customer account. The message instructs the customer to call a dedicated number to confirm activity and warns that transactions may be restricted for security purposes.
context: Trigger: Fraud detection rule triggered (moderate risk)
FirstUK: Unusual activity detected on your account. Call 0800-555-2265 to confirm.
For security, we may restrict transactions. Reply CONFIRM or call immediately.

name: Account Identifier
description: A placeholder for the customer's account reference or identifier, implied in the message context 'on your account' but not explicitly named as a variable in the template.
context: Unusual activity detected on your account

name: Support Phone Number
description: The dedicated phone number customers must call to confirm suspicious activity. Embedded in the template as 0800-555-2265.

name: Fraud Detection Rule Triggered
description: A fraud alert generated when the bank's fraud detection system identifies moderate-risk unusual activity on a customer account, triggering an immediate security notification to the customer.
context: Trigger: Fraud detection rule triggered (moderate risk)
Unusual activity detected on your account
generation_trigger: Moderate risk fraud detection rule activation
notification_content: Unusual activity alert with confirmation request
escalation_or_investigation_path: Customer contact required; transaction restrictions may be applied pending confirmation

name: Card Lost/Blocked Alert
description: A customer-facing alert notification triggered when a card is blocked due to fraud or loss. The template directs customers to online banking or branch channels and provides instructions for ordering a replacement card via phone or online.
context: Trigger: Card blocked due to fraud or loss
Your [product] card has been blocked. Use online banking or visit a branch.
Order replacement: Call 0800-555-2265 or online at www.firstuk.bank
trigger_event: Card blocked due to fraud or loss
key_content: Instructions to use online banking or visit branch

name: Product Type
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the specific card product name (e.g., debit card, credit card) that is blocked. Replaced at send time with the actual product name associated with the customer's account.

name: Replacement Card
description: A replacement card issued following the blocking of a customer's original card due to fraud or loss. The template provides multiple channels for customers to order the replacement.
context: Order replacement: Call 0800-555-2265 or online at www.firstuk.bank
block_or_replacement_conditions: Card blocked due to fraud or loss

name: Card Fraud Block Event
description: A fraud detection event that triggers automatic blocking of a customer's card. This alert initiates the customer notification process and replacement card ordering workflow.
context: Trigger: Card blocked due to fraud or loss
generation_trigger: Card blocked due to fraud detection
customer_notification: SMS alert with replacement ordering instructions
escalation_or_investigation_path: Card Services team via phone or online banking

name: Password Reset Initiated
description: An SMS notification template sent to customers when a password reset is requested. The message includes a time-limited reset link valid for 24 hours and instructs customers to ignore the message if they did not initiate the request.
context: FirstUK: Password reset requested. Click link to create new password: [short URL]. Expires in 24h. Ignore if you didn't request this.
key_content: Click link to create new password
Ignore if not requested by user

name: Password Reset Link
description: A time-limited URL placeholder that directs the customer to a password reset page. The link expires after 24 hours.
context: Click link to create new password: [short URL]

name: Link Expiration Time
description: The validity period for the password reset link, set at 24 hours from the time the template is sent.

name: 2FA Code (One-Time)
description: An SMS template delivering a one-time 6-digit security code to customers when two-factor authentication is required. The message includes expiration timing (5 minutes), a security warning against code sharing, and a customer support contact number for unauthorized requests.
context: FirstUK: Your security code is [6-digit code]. Never share this.
Code expires in 5 minutes. If you didn't request this, call 0800-555-2265.

name: 6-Digit Security Code
description: A dynamic placeholder for the one-time 6-digit authentication code generated and sent to the customer during two-factor authentication verification.

name: Customer Support Phone Number
description: A dynamic placeholder for the customer support contact number provided in the 2FA template for customers to report unauthorized authentication requests.
context: If you didn't request this, call 0800-555-2265.

name: Never Share Security Code
description: A mandatory prohibition communicated to customers that they must never share their one-time security code with any party, embedded as a security warning in the 2FA SMS template.

name: Unauthorized Two-Factor Authentication Request
description: A red flag indicating that a customer has received a 2FA code they did not request, signalling potential unauthorized access attempts or account takeover activity requiring immediate customer action.
context: If you didn't request this, call 0800-555-2265.
required_action: Contact customer support immediately at provided number

name: Account Opened Confirmation
description: SMS or push notification template sent to a customer immediately after successful creation of a new SmartSaver account. The message confirms account opening, provides the account number placeholder, directs the customer to log in via the online banking portal, and includes a customer service phone number for assistance.
context: FirstUK: Welcome! Your SmartSaver account is open. Account: [ACC-XXXXX]. Log in at www.firstuk.bank/login to activate.

name: Account Number
description: Placeholder variable representing the unique account identifier assigned to the newly opened account. Replaced at send time with the actual account number.

name: SmartSaver Account
description: A savings account product offered by FirstUK. Referenced in the account opening confirmation template as the product type being activated for new customers.
context: FirstUK: Welcome! Your SmartSaver account is open.
customer_facing_messaging: Welcome message emphasizing account activation and easy access to support

name: New SmartSaver Account
description: A newly created SmartSaver savings account that triggers the account opening confirmation communication. The account is ready for activation by the customer via online login.
context: Your SmartSaver account is open. Account: [ACC-XXXXX].
Log in at www.firstuk.bank/login to activate.

name: Interest Payment Notification
description: SMS or push notification template triggered by monthly interest credit to customer account. Confirms interest amount, new account balance, and provides contact number for queries. Includes AER disclosure.
context: FirstUK: Interest of £[amount] credited to your account. New balance: £[balance]. At 4.50% AER. Questions? Call 0800-555-2265

name: Interest Amount
description: Dynamic placeholder representing the sterling amount of interest credited to the customer's account in the current period.
context: Interest of £[amount] credited to your account

name: Account Balance
description: Dynamic placeholder representing the updated account balance following the interest credit.

name: FirstUK Account
description: Savings product offered by FirstUK that earns interest credited monthly at a stated AER rate.
context: FirstUK: Interest of £[amount] credited to your account

name: Standing Order Executed
description: SMS notification template sent to customer when a recurring standing order payment has been processed. Confirms the payment amount, payee, execution date, and current account balance, with a customer service contact number.
context: Trigger: Recurring standing order payment processed
FirstUK: Standing order of £[amount] to [payee] processed on [date]. Your balance: £[balance]. Call 0800-555-2265 with questions.

name: Standing Order Amount
description: Dynamic placeholder representing the monetary value of the standing order payment being executed, inserted into the notification message.

name: Payee Name
description: Dynamic placeholder for the name or identifier of the recipient organisation or person receiving the standing order payment.
context: Standing order of £[amount] to [payee] processed on

name: Payment Execution Date
description: Dynamic placeholder for the date on which the standing order payment was processed and executed.

name: Account Balance
description: Dynamic placeholder representing the customer's current account balance following the standing order payment execution.

name: Standing Order
description: Recurring payment instruction set up on a customer account to transfer funds to a named payee at regular intervals. This template notifies the customer when each payment is executed.
context: Standing order of £[amount] to [payee] processed on [date]

name: Account Verification Needed
description: A customer-facing notification template triggered when KYC documents are required to complete account verification. The template directs customers to upload identification documents via a web portal or telephone, specifies a deadline, and warns of account restrictions if verification is not completed.
context: We need your ID to complete verification. Upload at www.firstuk.bank/kyc or call 0800-555-2265. Deadline: [date].
Your account will be restricted if not completed.
key_content: Account restriction warning if not completed
compliance_disclosures: Account will be restricted if verification not completed

name: Verification Deadline
description: A dynamic date placeholder in the Account Verification Needed template that specifies the deadline by which the customer must complete KYC document upload or face account restrictions.

name: KYC Document Upload Verification
description: The KYC verification process requiring customers to upload identification documents via the FirstUK web portal or by telephone to complete account verification. Failure to complete within the specified deadline results in account restrictions.
context: We need your ID to complete verification. Upload at www.firstuk.bank/kyc or call 0800-555-2265.
Your account will be restricted if not completed.
verification_method: document upload via www.firstuk.bank/kyc or phone call to 0800-555-2265

name: KYC Document Submission Obligation
description: A mandatory compliance obligation requiring customers to submit identification documents for KYC verification within a specified deadline. Non-compliance triggers account restrictions as an enforcement mechanism.
context: We need your ID to complete verification.
Your account will be restricted if not completed.

name: Rate Change Alert
description: An SMS or push notification template triggered when a customer's interest rate is updated, typically on a monthly basis. The template informs the customer of the new rate in AER format, the previous rate, the Bank of England base rate movement, and when the new rate takes effect.
context: FirstUK: Your rate changed to [new rate]% AER (was [old rate]%).
Bank of England base rate moved to [new BoE rate]%. Your new interest starts next month.

name: New Interest Rate
description: The updated interest rate expressed as an Annual Equivalent Rate (AER) percentage that replaces the customer's previous rate.
context: Your rate changed to [new rate]% AER

name: Previous Interest Rate
description: The customer's former interest rate, shown in AER format for comparison with the new rate.

name: Bank of England Base Rate
description: The current Bank of England base rate that has moved and is provided as context for the customer's rate change.
context: Bank of England base rate moved to [new BoE rate]%.

name: Fraud Claim Resolved
description: SMS notification template sent to customer when a disputed transaction claim has been investigated and resolved. Includes dispute reference number, refund amount, and customer service contact details. Designed to confirm resolution and direct customer to email for full details.
context: Trigger: Disputed transaction investigated and resolved
FirstUK: Your dispute claim (Ref: [EXC-XXXXX]) has been resolved. Refund of £[amount] processed. See email for full details.

name: Dispute Reference Number
description: Unique identifier for the disputed transaction claim, formatted as EXC-XXXXX. Used to allow customer to reference their specific dispute in follow-up communications.
context: Your dispute claim (Ref: [EXC-XXXXX]) has been resolved.

name: Refund Amount
description: The monetary value of the refund processed to the customer's account as a result of the resolved dispute claim. Expressed in pounds sterling.

name: Disputed Transaction Investigation and Resolution
description: The process of investigating a customer's disputed transaction claim and communicating the resolution outcome. Triggers the Fraud Claim Resolved SMS template when investigation is complete and a refund decision has been made.
context: Trigger: Disputed transaction investigated and resolved
Your dispute claim (Ref: [EXC-XXXXX]) has been resolved.
generation_trigger: Customer dispute claim submitted and investigation completed

name: Disputed Transaction
description: A financial transaction on a customer account that has been challenged by the customer and subsequently investigated. The resolution of this dispute triggers the Fraud Claim Resolved notification.
context: Your dispute claim (Ref: [EXC-XXXXX]) has been resolved.

name: Branch Appointment Reminder
description: An SMS reminder sent 24 hours before a scheduled branch meeting, notifying the customer of their appointment details and providing a contact number to reschedule if needed.
context: FirstUK: Reminder: You have an appointment at [branch name] on [date] at [time]. Contact 0800-555-2265 if you need to reschedule.
trigger_event: Scheduled branch meeting 24 hours before appointment

name: Branch Name
description: The name of the FirstUK branch where the customer's appointment is scheduled, inserted dynamically into the reminder message.

name: Appointment Date
description: The date of the scheduled branch appointment, inserted dynamically into the reminder message.

name: Appointment Time
description: The time of the scheduled branch appointment, inserted dynamically into the reminder message.

name: Account Closure Confirmation
description: An SMS notification template sent to customers when their account closure has been processed. The message confirms closure, provides a reference number, specifies the final balance transfer method and timeline, and includes a customer service contact number.
context: FirstUK: Your account has been closed (Ref: [ACC-XXXXX]). Final balance of £[amount] will be transferred to [method] within 3–5 days. Call 0800-555-2265 with questions.

name: Account Reference Number
description: A unique account reference identifier inserted into the Account Closure Confirmation template to identify the specific closed account.

name: Final Balance Amount
description: The monetary value of the customer's final account balance to be transferred upon closure, inserted as a dynamic variable in the confirmation message.
context: Final balance of £[amount] will be transferred to [method]

name: Transfer Method
description: The destination or mechanism for transferring the final balance upon account closure, inserted as a dynamic variable in the confirmation message.
context: Final balance of £[amount] will be transferred to [method] within 3–5 days

name: Closed Account
description: A customer account that has been closed and for which a final balance transfer is being processed within 3–5 days.
context: Final balance of £[amount] will be transferred to [method] within 3–5 days
closure_or_freeze_conditions: Final balance transferred to designated method within 3–5 days

name: Maintenance Notice
description: A service notification template sent to customers to inform them of scheduled system maintenance affecting online and mobile banking availability. The template specifies the maintenance window, affected services, and reassures customers of service restoration.
context: Online/mobile banking temporarily unavailable. Sorry for any inconvenience. We'll be back soon!

name: Maintenance Date
description: A dynamic date placeholder in the Maintenance Notice template that is replaced with the specific date of the scheduled system maintenance at send time.

name: Survey Request Template
description: A brief post-transaction or post-support survey invitation template designed to gather customer feedback on their banking experience. The template includes a direct link to an online survey and emphasizes the minimal time commitment required.
context: FirstUK: How did we do? Rate your experience: www.firstuk.bank/survey
Takes 1 minute. Thanks for banking with us!

name: Survey URL
description: A dynamic placeholder for the survey web address that customers are directed to in order to provide feedback on their banking experience.

name: Unrecognized Login Alert
description: A security alert template triggered when a login attempt is detected from a new device or location. The message notifies the customer of the login attempt with date, time, and location/device details, and instructs them to change their password immediately or contact the fraud line if the login was unauthorized.
context: Trigger: Login from new device or location
If not you, change password immediately: www.firstuk.bank/reset or call 0800-555-2265 fraud line.
trigger_event: Login from new device or location
key_content: Login attempt notification with date, time, and location/device
Instruction to change password if unrecognized

name: Login Attempt Date
description: The date on which the unrecognized login attempt occurred, inserted dynamically into the alert message.

name: Login Attempt Time
description: The time at which the unrecognized login attempt occurred, inserted dynamically into the alert message.

name: Login Location or Device
description: The geographic location or device identifier from which the login attempt was made, inserted dynamically into the alert message to help the customer identify whether the access was authorized.

name: Unrecognized Login Attempt Detection
description: A fraud detection alert generated when a login is attempted from a new device or location not previously associated with the customer account. The alert triggers an automated security notification to the customer with instructions to verify the login or reset their password.
context: Trigger: Login from new device or location
If not you, change password immediately: www.firstuk.bank/reset or call 0800-555-2265 fraud line.
generation_trigger: Login from new device or location
investigation_or_escalation_path: Customer self-assessment via alert response; escalation to fraud line if customer confirms unauthorized access
notification_content: Login attempt details with password reset and fraud line contact instructions

name: Password Reset Requirement on Unrecognized Login
canonical_name: Password Reset Requirement on Unrecognized Login
description: The customer must change their password immediately if they do not recognize the login attempt from a new device or location. This is a security control obligation communicated through the alert template.
context: If not you, change password immediately: www.firstuk.bank/reset or call 0800-555-2265 fraud line.
required_action: Change password immediately if login attempt is not recognized
verification_method: Customer-initiated password reset via secure portal or fraud line confirmation

name: Fraud Line Contact Obligation on Unauthorized Login
canonical_name: Fraud Line Contact Obligation on Unauthorized Login

description: The customer must contact the fraud line at 0800-555-2265 if they do not recognize the login attempt, enabling the bank to investigate and take protective action on the account.
context: If not you, change password immediately: www.firstuk.bank/reset or call 0800-555-2265 fraud line.
required_action: Contact fraud line if login attempt is not recognized

name: Payment Reversal Notification
description: An SMS notification template triggered when a customer transaction is reversed or refunded. The template confirms the reversal amount, recipient, and refund credit to the account, and provides a reference number and customer service contact for queries.
context: FirstUK: Transaction of £[amount] to [recipient] has been reversed. Refund credited to your account. Ref: [EXC-XXXXX]. Call 0800-555-2265 if you have questions.

name: Transaction Amount
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the monetary value of the transaction that has been reversed, inserted into the Payment Reversal Notification template.
context: Transaction of £[amount] to [recipient] has been reversed

name: Recipient Name
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the name or identifier of the payee to whom the original transaction was directed, inserted into the Payment Reversal Notification template.
context: Transaction of £[amount] to [recipient] has been reversed

name: Reversal Reference Number
description: A dynamic placeholder for the unique reference identifier assigned to the reversed transaction, formatted as EXC-XXXXX, used for customer inquiry and transaction tracking.

name: Reversed Transaction
description: A financial transaction that has been reversed or refunded back to the customer's account, triggering the Payment Reversal Notification template. The reversal includes a credit to the customer's account and a reference number for tracking.
context: Transaction of £[amount] to [recipient] has been reversed

name: SMS Communication Guidelines
description: A set of mandatory guidelines governing SMS communication design, character limits, tone, content restrictions, and security protocols for all SMS-based customer communications. Establishes requirements for support contact inclusion, reference codes, sensitive data handling, and opt-out mechanisms.
context: Keep under 160 where possible to avoid multi-part charges
Always include phone number for support
Never ask for sensitive info via SMS (PIN, full account number)
All SMS templates should include note that customers can opt out of non-critical alerts via online banking settings

name: SMS Character Limit Compliance
description: Requirement to maintain SMS messages within specified character limits to control costs and ensure delivery as single or multi-part messages. Standard SMS must not exceed 160 characters; multi-part SMS limited to 153 characters per part.
context: Multi-part SMS: 153 characters per part (if needed)
Keep under 160 where possible to avoid multi-part charges
key_requirement: keep SMS under 160 characters where possible to avoid multi-part charges

name: SMS Support Contact Inclusion
description: Requirement that all SMS communications must include a phone number for customer support to enable customers to reach assistance when needed.
context: Always include phone number for support
requirement: always include phone number for customer support

name: SMS Sensitive Data Protection
description: Prohibition against transmitting sensitive customer information via SMS, including full account numbers, passwords, PINs, detailed personal information, and long URLs. Only last 4 digits of account numbers may be used.
context: Never ask for sensitive info via SMS (PIN, full account number)
Full account numbers (use last 4 digits only)
regulatory_source: data protection and banking security standards
consequence_of_failure: data breach, regulatory violation, customer harm

name: SMS Opt-Out Notification
description: Requirement that all SMS templates must include a note informing customers of their right to opt out of non-critical alerts through online banking settings.
context: All SMS templates should include note that customers can opt out of non-critical alerts via online banking settings
requirement: include note that customers can opt out of non-critical alerts via online banking settings

name: SMS Reference Code
description: A dynamic placeholder for transaction or confirmation reference codes to be included in SMS communications where possible to provide customers with trackable identifiers for their transactions or alerts.
usage_guidance: include reference or confirmation codes when possible

name: Customer Support Phone Number
description: A dynamic placeholder for the customer support phone number to be included in all SMS communications to enable customers to contact the bank for assistance.
context: Always include phone number for support
usage_guidance: always include phone number for support

name: Account Number Last Four Digits
description: A dynamic placeholder for the last four digits of a customer's account number, used in SMS communications as a secure alternative to transmitting full account numbers.
context: Full account numbers (use last 4 digits only)
usage_guidance: use last 4 digits only; never include full account number

name: Transmission of Sensitive Data via SMS
canonical_name: Transmission of Sensitive Data via SMS
key: transmission of sensitive data via sms|WARNING_SIGN|banking.communications
description: A red flag indicating potential security and compliance violations when SMS communications contain full account numbers, passwords, PINs, or other sensitive personal information that should never be transmitted via SMS.
context: Never ask for sensitive info via SMS (PIN, full account number)
Full account numbers (use last 4 digits only)
required_action: do not include sensitive data in SMS messages; use last 4 digits of account number only
false_positive_guidance: reference codes and support phone numbers are acceptable; only full account numbers, passwords, and PINs are prohibited

name: Initial SMS Templates
description: A collection of SMS communication templates established as the initial version of the bank's SMS messaging framework. These templates form the foundational set of customer-facing SMS communications.
context: Version 1.0 | 2026-01-15 | Initial SMS templates | Head of Marketing
